name: How long does kitchen countertop installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does kitchen countertop installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for kitchen countertops varies depending on the material, project complexity, and cabinet preparation. Generally, after template creation, fabrication can take 1-3 weeks. The actual installation usually takes 1-2 days. This timeframe can be extended if existing countertops need to be removed, if custom cuts or complex layouts are involved, or if additional services like plumbing disconnections/reconnections are part of the scope. We provide a detailed timeline after the initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Countertop installation typically takes 1-3 weeks for fabrication after templating, with the actual installation lasting 1-2 days.
